description: Spec 036 Teil 5 ③ (Spec 029 ③): copy of valid/dokumentaro-plena whose butono lacks the three fields of its documentation – when-not, do-dont and keyboard. The Vitrino page of an Ero shows nine sections; three of them are written in the Uzo, so a Uzo without them leaves the page with holes. check:dokumentaro reports each missing field as an error.
